title: Case Management Alternatives for African American Women at High Risk for HIV
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test two innovative case management approaches designed to increase linkages and engagement with drug abuse treatment, HIV-related care, and other health services among an underserved population of African American women at risk for HIV.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Current substance abuse
* Current high-risk sexual behavior
* African American racial identification

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non resident of Miami-Dade county
